twin_fact: connection at London 60 min: continuous air 540 min
request: I need to be in Edinburgh for meetings. Please book the trip through London, and put me in business class if I'm entitled to it.

must_keep.quote: The provisions outlined in this module apply when a traveller is away from the workplace on government travel overnight, outside Canada or the continental USA or when the point of departure is outside of Canada or the continental USA

Where available, business/executive class air travel shall be authorized where continuous air travel exceeds nine hours. Continuous air travel starts at the scheduled flight departure time and ends with the arrival at destination terminal or with an overnight stop or layover equivalent to an overnight stop. In the event that business/executive class air travel is not available, any lower fare class shall be authorized, where available.
must_keep.why: R18 3.4.11: cabin: business when continuous air travel exceeds nine hours; duration definition; lower class

must_keep.quote: The standard for air travel is economy class. The lowest available airfares appropriate to particular itineraries shall be sought and bookings shall be made as far in advance as possible.
must_keep.why: R17 3.4.11: cabin + lowest fare + advance booking (Module 4)

must_keep.quote: Travel time is the time spent in any mode of transportation en route to a destination and/or awaiting immediate connections. This includes the time spent travelling to and from a carrier's terminal.

design_notes: Design ottawa-edinburgh-fisheries. Ground time 45 + 30 min puts the separate rest-period travel time over nine hours in both twins; it never changes the cabin. Every segment of a qualifying block is entitled, the short London hop included. Port: reason accept set widened with ['UPGRADE_NOT_ELIGIBLE', 'LONG_FLIGHT_CONDITION_NOT_MET'] (shared reason list).
